summary: Minimal, correct fix that normalizes dimensionless Function-argument dimensions to Dimension(1) so downstream dimension equality checks (e.g. in addition) recognize them as dimensionless. Preserves prior behavior for non-dimensionless args, no regression risk.

issues.description: No inline comment explaining why dimensionless dims are coerced to Dimension(1) (is_dimensionless True but object not literally Dimension(1)); a one-line comment would aid future readers.
